subject: Visit timing update
text:
Hello,

I have reviewed the schedule for next week’s visit and wanted to confirm details. The main office is open from ten in the morning until four in the afternoon. We can meet in the small conference room on the second floor.

A rail service disruption may affect the 9:15 connection, so the first hour could start late. I suggest we keep the visit to the original length but begin with paperwork. If the delay becomes serious, we can shift the meeting to Thursday.

Please confirm whether that works.
